inventory.notes: Initial inventory covers extension runtime, configuration, operational scripts and test infrastructure. Descriptions were reviewed against current owning paths and existing evidence; no fresh real-NAS run, Firefox runtime parity or universal feature discovery is implied. Source-file coverage is independent of the feature denominator. Confirmed cleanup candidates and scope differences are recorded in docs/system/feature-review.md.

features.title: QNAP transport, login, sessions and API errors
features.notes: Typed client, SID middleware, login encoding/replay, task methods and schema were compared with current sources; hardware interoperability is not inferred.

review.reason: Compared the typed client, explicit multipart login, single-flight SID middleware and one URL-encoded replay with the API README and login/client tests; no hardware guarantee is inferred.

features.title: Connection form and persistent settings
features.notes: Storage precedence, local credential persistence, schema migration, configured-vs-health state and five-second login check were inspected.

review.reason: Compared Save/Test/Remove lifecycle, 2.5-second plain-save confirmation, current connection invalidation, retained credential storage and five-second check boundary with Settings code and Chromium connection regressions.

features.title: Optional Settings-screen password
features.notes: PBKDF2 verifier, session unlock and Settings-only mounting were inspected; no encrypted-credential guarantee is claimed.

review.reason: Compared unchanged PBKDF2/session unlock and Settings-only protection with the shared Settings callback change; canonical storage section still excludes credential encryption.

features.title: Non-secret settings export and import
features.notes: Portable keys, parser boundaries, password exclusion and confirmation path were compared with code and existing tests.

review.reason: Compared unchanged portable import/export key filtering and confirmation with the changed shared Settings component; backup behavior and tests remain accurate.

features.title: First-match routing and rule editor
features.notes: Classification, release-name routing, domains, list/glob matching and editor behavior were inspected; batch routing difference is explicit.

review.reason: Compared unchanged first-match destination resolution and rule editor with uploads callback isolation and shared Settings change; local descriptor routing and documented per-batch destination limitation remain unchanged.

features.title: NAS folder selection and validation
features.notes: Relative paths, parent listing, writability and invalid-vs-unverifiable outcomes were inspected; permissions can change after validation.

review.reason: Compared relative normalization, parent directory lookup, writtable flag, error 4096 and five-minute endpoint/login folder cache with the page and tests.

features.title: Transactional browser torrent hand-off
features.notes: Event claims, deferred filename, live login, tracker fetch, cancel-after-accept and browser fallback were inspected; BUG-70 remains unproven.

review.reason: Compared accepted AddTorrent ordering, rejected failure-episode cleanup isolation, cancel/erase and actual preacceptance fallback against downloads regression and interception E2E; no live NAS claim.

features.title: Page magnet and scoped ordinary-file sends
features.notes: Eligible click gates, download attributes/path allow-list, Shift override, worker messages, cleanup/reinjection and navigation fallback were inspected.

review.reason: Compared trusted click gates, HTTP pathname/download-attribute eligibility, Shift override, magnet/file messages, terminal page feedback, cleanup/reinjection and browser navigation fallback.

features.title: Explicit context-menu link sends
features.notes: Menu reinitialization, URL support, shared classification/routing, monitoring and direct failure notifications were inspected.

review.reason: Verified that exactly one link-context menu is created, that menu/content file sends share transport, and that explicit menu failures use direct notification; removed the invented open-NAS menu claim.

features.title: Local torrent and batch URL submission
features.notes: Current success/duplicate/error messages, release-name routing for local files and the 50-line independent URL outcomes were inspected.

review.reason: Compared full/partial/duplicate acceptance, sync/async follow-up failure, status receipts and suppression after newer direct feedback or invalid submission against real-renderer tests and browser upload interleaving; no durable queue.

features.title: Live task list, filtering and task details
features.notes: Current-query rendering, live shared selection, abort/controller identity, connection generation and removal reconciliation were inspected; the unread parallel snapshot is removed.

review.reason: Compared query abort/controller identity, connection generation, recovery and removal reconciliation; rechecked removal of unread snapshot producer/listeners while preserving selection and current query rendering.

features.title: Task actions, queue order and torrent file priority
features.notes: Start/pause/stop/remove, clean-delete confirmation, SetTaskPriority and GetFile/SetFile call paths were inspected.

review.reason: Compared caught Start/Stop/Pause/Remove rejection, typed unsupported-Pause Stop outcome including transport failure, independent removal-marker owner and newer command precedence against orchestration tests and Chromium regressions.

features.title: Alarm polling, badge and attention state
features.notes: 30-second alarms, single badge writer, session state, authoritative zero handling and stopping on polling failure were inspected; full Task/Query is still used.

review.reason: Compared unchanged single toolbar writer, progress summary bridge and actionable-attention acknowledgement with current popup query invalidation; poll feedback recovery does not clear worker attention.

features.title: Page, popup and system feedback
features.notes: Direct/poll ownership, scoped recovery, episode dismissal, timer receipt guards and accepted-outcome isolation are verified for targeted popup regressions; wider native/page policy remains open.

review.reason: Compared direct/poll ownership, scoped recovery, episode dismissal/reset, timer replacement, accepted-outcome callbacks and typed control failures with real-renderer and browser regressions; native/page secondary-surface policy remains open.

features.title: Svelte popup composition and UI primitives
features.notes: Entrypoint mounting, native themed dismissal, panel invalidation and active primitives were inspected; unused Card is removed.

review.reason: Compared themed native keyboard dismissal and existing popup mounting/panel callbacks; removed unused Card/barrel after consumer search; active primitives and accessibility checks remain intact.

features.title: Saved Auto, Light and Dark preference
features.notes: Theme application, immediate saving, OS listener replacement and page-toast theme behavior were inspected.

review.reason: Compared unchanged Auto/Light/Dark storage and listener behavior plus dismiss-control token usage with interface docs and browser theme checks; no theme API or source change.

features.title: Browser builds, quality gates and release ownership
features.notes: Manifests, build targets, CI/deploy scripts, direct Store API uploader and Rulesync generation were compared; no new deployment or Firefox runtime claim.

review.reason: Added local read-only audit/report/self-test scripts to package.json; existing build, release ownership and publication commands are unchanged. Development-release documentation remains accurate.

features.title: Storybook, store assets, demo and manual stand
features.notes: Harness entrypoints and consumers were inventoried; compilation/capture quality is not inferred, and undeclared manual-stand tsx remains open.

review.reason: Compared Card/helper removals with positive popup-size and HTTP-bundle callers, preserved assets/demo/stand ownership and Storybook build; undeclared stand tsx remains open.

features.title: Mocks, fixture servers and real-NAS ownership
features.notes: Vitest projects, Chrome/MSW mocks, test stand and spotcheck ownership/redaction were inspected; no fresh hardware run is claimed.

review.reason: Reviewed AST/Svelte/HTML callable inventory, five scanner regression cases, hash-bound manual manifest and permitted test-fixture any. Updated verification page to distinguish static candidates from executed behavior and hardware evidence.

features.title: Feature registry, reviews, language and drift guards
features.notes: Checker, explicit review command, English guard, staged inspection and source-discovery boundaries were inspected and exercised by self-tests.

review.reason: Compared the unchanged documentation checker with the added callable-evidence maintenance instructions: source-hash manual review complements feature documentation, with explicit report generation and no feature denominator change.
